query: my job downloads a model into the mounted bucket and crashes with [Errno 1] Operation not permitted
expected_behavior: Explains the bucket is a FUSE mount that is read-mostly and rejects atomic rename / chmod / mmap, which is why copytree/copy2 and HF Xet / hf_transfer writes fail
For staging weights, recommends downloading to local disk then copying data-only (shutil.copyfile inside os.walk, not copytree)
For live read-write, recommends a filesystem mount or the boto3 S3 API instead of the bucket FUSE mount
Notes read inputs should be mounted ro
Does not misdiagnose it as a permissions/IAM error
